title: Coherent adjunction data with universal unit and counit
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces and coherent comma categories as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For simplicial maps $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, coherent adjunction data consist of edges $\eta:\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal C}\to RL$ and $\epsilon:LR\to\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal D}$ in the full internal functor simplicial sets. There is a $2$-simplex in $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C,\mathcal D)$ with successive edges $L\eta,\epsilon L$ and long edge the degenerate identity at $L$, and a $2$-simplex in $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal D,\mathcal C)$ with successive edges $\eta R,R\epsilon$ and long edge the degenerate identity at $R$. For each $c$, the pair $(Lc,\eta_c)$ is initial in $(c\downarrow R)$; for each $d$, the pair $(Rd,\epsilon_d)$ is terminal in $(L\downarrow d)$. The component edges are evaluation of the specified coherent unit and counit themselves, so the universal maps and their coherences are retained.
